name: rq3_dual_threshold_v1
description: Same pre-registered split as rq3_threshold_v1; score replaced by max(rolling-median JS, global-median JS, luma) before CUSUM. Selection still uses validation only.

split.rule: sha256(sequence name) ascending; first 4 validation, rest test

selection.criterion: max mean F1 subject to mean precision >= 0.60

notes: Only the score construction changes vs rq3_threshold_v1; split, grid and selection rule are identical.
The global-median term keeps a clean reference for sustained plateaus; the rolling term handles slow drift.
